title: Implement: a pair made of functions

checklist.step: cons keeps both parts and hands them to whatever asks
cdr recovers the second part of any such pair

hints: The pair does not decide which part to give back. Whoever asks supplies the decision.
Look at car: what does it pass to the pair, and what must the pair do with it for car to get x?
cons returns a one-argument function that calls its argument on x and y. cdr passes the pair a two-argument function that returns its second argument.
